features:
Key Features:

Mixed Variety of Ingredients: Combines crunchy corn Chex, wheat Chex, rye chips, mini breadsticks, pretzels, and bagel chips—all seasoned to perfection.

Bold Savory Flavor: Seasoned with a classic blend of spices like onion, garlic, and Worcestershire for a rich, salty taste.

Light on Fat: Contains significantly less fat compared to regular potato chips—about 60% less per serving.

Ready-to-Eat Convenience: Available in portioned packs and large party bags for on-the-go snacking or sharing.

Crunchy Texture: Delivers a satisfying crunch in every bite, thanks to its baked-not-fried components.

Benefits:

Satisfying Variety: Different textures and shapes in each handful keep the snack interesting and satisfying.

Lower Guilt Snacking: Offers a lighter option for chip lovers who want to reduce fat without sacrificing flavor.

Perfect for Sharing: Ideal for parties, road trips, lunchboxes, or office snacking—everyone finds something they like.

No Prep Needed: Enjoyable straight from the bag, with no mess or additional ingredients required.

Some Whole Grain Content: Depending on the mix, it includes whole grain ingredients that contribute to fiber intake.
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Whole Wheat, Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, riboflavin, thiamin mononitrate, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (soybean, high oleic soybean, high oleic canola, high oleic sunflower, fractionated palm, palm olein and/or palm), Rye Flour, Sugar. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Yeast, Maltodextrin, Baking Soda, Spice, Dextrose, Caramel Color, Distilled Monoglycerides, Malted Barley Extract, Barley Malt Syrup, Autolyzed Yeast, Yellow Corn Flour, Trisodium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Dried Onion, Dried Garlic, Hydrolyzed Soy Protein, Rye Flour, Fumaric Acid, Citric Acid, Caraway, Disodium Inosinate, Disodium Guanylate, Paprika Extract (color), Natural Flavor, Sodium Diacetate. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
